english.title: Attempt aggravated burglary - dwelling
english.standardoffencewording:

(B)_[part of a dwelling,]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
where the specific date of the offence is not known, the charge should read: "...on a date between X and Y...". where 'X' is the last date before the first date on which the offence could have occurred, and 'Y' is the first date after the last date it could have occurred.
(e.g. a factory closes Friday evening to Monday morning. It is broken into over the weekend. The charge should read: "...on a date between X (Thursday's date) and Y (Tuesday's date)...".)

attempt to enter as a trespasser
a dwelling / part of a dwelling
with the intention of stealing property / inflicting GBH
at the time had with you a
firearm(s) / imitation firearm(s) / weapon(s) of offence / explosive(s)

Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
